main.description: An audit-logged moderation action written as the school by the app. A written reason is mandatory for the ACTION, and is kept app-side: moderation reasons are never public. Never edits another repo; it controls the school's own listing/roles.

subjectRecord.description: DEPRECATED, never written by this app: an at-uri's authority segment is a DID, and no public record may name a DID its holder did not write (R9). The record acted on is kept app-side, in fs_moderation_queue.subject_uri.

subjectDid.description: DEPRECATED, never written by this app (R9: no public record may name a DID its holder did not write). The account acted on is kept app-side, in fs_moderation_queue.subject_did.

reason.description: DEPRECATED, never written by this app: moderation reasons are never public. A reason is MANDATORY for the action and is stored app-side, in fs_moderation_queue.reason and fs_audit.reason. Free text a steward wrote about a specific person publishes both a judgement and, in practice, enough detail to identify its subject.

actors.description: Stewards who approved. Destructive actions require the policy threshold.
